items.question: What is StingClaw?
items.answer: A local app for running named AI agents. Chat through a local web interface or Telegram.

items.question: Does my data leave my computer?
items.answer: Agent settings and conversation history are stored locally. Messages you send to an agent go to the model provider you choose through OpenRouter. Public web search also sends requests to the configured web search provider.

items.question: Can an agent change my files without asking?
items.answer: File edits and shell actions are staged for your review. You approve or reject proposed changes before they are applied.

items.question: Which models can I use?
items.answer: You can choose models available through OpenRouter and use your own API keys.

items.question: What do I need to run StingClaw?
items.answer: You need Bun and an OpenRouter API key. StingClaw currently uses Windows user-level encryption to store API keys, so Windows is the supported platform.

items.question: Can I use StingClaw from my phone?
items.answer: Yes, through Telegram. Your computer and StingClaw background service must be running.

items.question: Does it keep working when I close the browser?
items.answer: Yes, while your computer and the background service are running. If you stop the service or turn off the computer, tasks cannot continue.
